name: privmask
title: Privacy Mask
description: Find personal information in text and mask it before you share it, entirely on your Mac — Japanese names, addresses and My Numbers included.
author: snaka

commands.name: mask-text
commands.title: Mask Text
commands.description: Review the personal information found in your selection or clipboard, then copy the masked text.

preferences.name: useModel
preferences.title: Detection
preferences.label: Use the on-device language model
preferences.description: The main source of Japanese personal names. Requires macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence; without it, names are found only by the privmask name model, when that is installed.

preferences.name: useNameModel
preferences.label: Use the privmask name model when installed
preferences.description: A trained model for Japanese personal names that comes with the privmask CLI (brew install snaka/tap/privmask). It runs on any macOS 13 or later, so names are still found without Apple Intelligence.

preferences.name: nameModelPath
preferences.title: Name Model
preferences.description: The directory holding ner.mlmodelc. Leave empty to use the one installed with the privmask CLI by Homebrew.

preferences.name: dictionaryPath
preferences.title: Term List
preferences.description: A plain text file, one term per line: customer names, company names, project code names. Shared with the privmask CLI.
